title: Generate active operational state from SQLite with separate annotations
description: Implement the approved TASK-277 generated-state slice using TASK-276 drift evidence. Replace hand-maintained lifecycle fields in the active-lane surface with an idempotent SQLite projection while preserving compact human rationale and gate annotations in a separate keyed source. Do not parse free prose as lifecycle truth.
acceptance_criteria: Active task lifecycle fields are generated from canonical map.db and cannot drift through ordinary claim, submit, approve, or release transitions.
Human-authored rationale and gate annotations are stored separately by task ID and survive idempotent regeneration.
The generator never treats free-prose task mentions as lifecycle state and reports orphan or stale annotations explicitly.
Focused tests cover each lifecycle transition, annotation preservation, deterministic ordering, and repeated no-op regeneration.
Current-state and task-mirror validators pass, with a migration and rollback note in the delivery artifact.
